title: What shall we do tomorrow?
summary: Two friends make plans for the weekend.

sentences.zh: 小月，明天是星期六，你想做什么？
sentences.en: Xiaoyue, tomorrow is Saturday. What would you like to do?
I'd like to see a film. And you?
I want to see a film too!
OK. What time shall we go?

sentences.zh: 下午两点，在电影院前边见，怎么样？
sentences.en: Two in the afternoon, meet in front of the cinema, how about that?

sentences.zh: 好。看了电影，我们去吃饭吧。
sentences.en: OK. After the film, let's go and eat.
Great! I'd like to eat dumplings.

questions.prompt: What will they do tomorrow afternoon?
why: Right: 我们明天下午去（看电影）吧.
Tomorrow is Saturday; school isn't mentioned.
No one is ill in this dialogue.
They meet at the cinema, not at home.
The restaurant comes after the film.

questions.prompt: What does Xiaoyue want to eat?
